scope: Proposition 13.5 (Uniform finite-volume collection bound) of the manuscript “Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape” (preprints/Strict-convexity-and-differentiability-of-the-planar-exponential-first-passage-limit-shape-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the iid tunnel field associated with any fixed local type and phase template there are constants C, C0 < ∞, independent of n and the input-road rule, such that the following holds. Let Gn(L) be the maximum of P p∈Γ Yp over finite distinct chains in an arbitrary deterministic translated coordinate square of side at most L, whose consecutive differences have both coordinates at least 2S. The empty chain and singletons are allowed. Then EGn(L) ≤ CL + C0. (13.13) The same bound therefore holds if consecutive differences are additionally required to lie in any fixed inner cone of the positive quadrant.
